text_block_list.text:
King-san, having conquered the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Despite crushing 
the dreams of up-and-comers and facing 
criticism, she proudly declared, "This is 
my path."

Through her back and her words... King-san 
showed me that I should "take pride in 
being true to myself"!

"...Stay true to yourself without fear of 
getting hurt! To hold my head high in that 
same spirit, I've decided to take the 
stage at the Fan Appreciation Festival's 
talk show."

Yes, of course I am scared. But... I have 
someone by my side who tells me that I am 
not alone...!
